purpose: Parallel research tracks that inform product but don't block pilot
priority_policy: P1 is highest for research (P0 reserved for pilot blockers)

eigenspace_simulation.description: Agent-based simulation for coordination mechanism optimization using eigenspace entropy
eigenspace_simulation.hypothesis: Maximizing entropy of satisfaction across eigenspace preserves value pluralism better than efficiency-maximizing or majority-satisfying mechanisms
eigenspace_simulation.publication_potential: Methodology paper on simulated mechanism design with LLM-derived value spaces

simulated_citizen_class.description: Agent that samples from eigenspace with position vector
simulated_citizen_class.acceptance: SimulatedCitizen class with eigenspace_position, can evaluate decisions

multi_dimensional_satisfaction.description: Satisfaction model: outcome, process, relative, trajectory, autonomy

behavioral_responses.description: Exit, voice, adaptation behaviors based on satisfaction state
behavioral_responses.acceptance: Agents can exit, reduce participation, or adapt preferences

decision_generator.description: Generate synthetic decisions with eigenspace impact profiles
decision_generator.acceptance: Decision class with eigenspace impact vector, can generate realistic proposals

citizen_swarm.description: Manage population of agents, run decisions through them
citizen_swarm.acceptance: CitizenSwarm can sample N agents, run decisions, track state over time

simulation_runner.acceptance: Can run N episodes, output metrics over time, save results

mechanism_testbed.description: Test different coordination mechanisms against simulated swarm
mechanism_testbed.acceptance: Can swap coordination mechanisms, compare entropy outcomes

langgraph_bridge.description: Connect simulation to existing LangGraph coordination
langgraph_bridge.acceptance: Simulated agents can participate in coordination workflows

sim_to_real_framework.description: Compare simulation predictions to pilot observations
sim_to_real_framework.acceptance: Framework to log predictions, compare to real data post-pilot

calibration_protocol.description: Protocol for updating agent models based on real data
calibration_protocol.acceptance: Documented process for Bayesian updating of simulation parameters

governance_theory.description: Theoretical foundations connecting computation, governance, and value pluralism

entropy_as_objective.description: Entropy of value-specific satisfaction as governance objective function
key_questions: Does high eigenspace entropy correlate with felt legitimacy?
What measure over possible value space?

computational_governance_analogies.description: Mapping governance concepts to computational primitives
key_analogies: State law as hard memory / ROM
Court decisions as JIT compilation / memoization
